segments.text:
V. 28.
Come to me—Here He ſhews to whom He is pleaſed to reveal theſe Things; to the weary and heavy laden: Ye that labour— After Reſt in GOD: And are heavy la•en—With the Guilt and Power of Sin: And I will give you reſt—I alone (for none elſe can) will freely give you (what ye cannot purchaſe) Reſt from the Guilt of Sin by Juſtification, and from the Power of Sin by Sanctification.
